description: In the Webots robotics simulator, open the soccer demo world via File > Open Sample World, then start the simulation by clicking the play button.

natural_language.prompt: Using the Webots robotics simulator, open the 'soccer' demo world. Navigate to File > Open Sample World, then browse to the 'demos' category and select the 'soccer.wbt' world file. After the world finishes loading (you will see a soccer field with robots), start the simulation by clicking the real-time play button (the right-pointing triangle icon) in the toolbar at the top of the window. The simulation should be running in real-time mode with robots moving on the field.
